c49_hypothesis.name: Volume Kurtosis Shock Mean Reversion (Liquidity Tail-Fatness Burst Fade)
c49_hypothesis.description: Compute rolling excess kurtosis (Fisher, 4th-moment) of real quote volume over 24h, z-score over 168h (causal) -> kurt_z. Fade extreme tail-fatness/spiky liquidity shocks: kurt_z >= 1.25 and ret_W>0 -> SHORT; kurt_z >= 1.25 and ret_W<0 -> LONG. Extreme platykurtic calm (kurt_z <= -1.25) -> no entry (pre-stated asymmetry). Exit on kurt_z < 0.25, max hold 12h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 trades high vol_z LEVEL (first-moment volume z) momentum continuation; C49 uses z-score of rolling EXCESS KURTOSIS of qvol (4th-moment tail-fatness) as a shock fade.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH volume climax on aggregate vol_z level; C49 fades TAIL-FATNESS (kurtosis) of volume — different transform (4th moment shape, not volume level).
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 continues on LOW vol_z dry-up breakout; C49 mean-reverts on extreme volume tail-fatness shocks (high kurt_z).
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms breakouts on volume expansion (level); C49 uses volume kurtosis (tail shape) shock fade, no breakout/expansion confirmation.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades volume-price divergence using unsloped vol_z at price extremes; C49 uses kurt_z (tail-fatness of volume) shock with ret_W confirmation — different transform and trigger.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c44: C44 trend-follows on vol_z ROC acceleration; C49 mean-reverts on extreme kurt_z tail-fatness shocks, no ROC/acceleration.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c45: C45 mean-reverts on Amihud illiquidity shocks (|ret|/volume, price-impact ratio); C49 uses rolling excess kurtosis of qvol (tail shape), not a price-impact ratio.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c46: C46 continues on OBV (cumulative sign*vol) slope divergence vs price slope; C49 uses kurt_z tail-fatness shock fade — different transform (4th moment vs OBV slopes) and opposite mechanic.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c47: C47 uses up/down volume split imbalance ratio (directional partitioned sums) exhaustion fade; C49 uses rolling excess kurtosis of total qvol (undirected tail-shape/4th moment) — different construction.
c49_hypothesis.differs_from_c48: C48 uses z-score of rolling STD of qvol (2nd-moment dispersion/volatility-of-liquidity); C49 uses z-score of rolling EXCESS KURTOSIS of qvol (4th-moment tail-fatness/spikiness) — distinct higher-moment statistic measuring tail shape, not dispersion magnitude.
